name: rayedbajwa-spaces
description: The AI software factory for your team: specs go in, reviewed and tested pull requests come out. An assembly line of agents (research → specify → plan → tasks → implement → review → verify → deliver) with human gates, on GitHub Spec Kit and the Pi Coding Agent SDK, following AIDLC. GitHub/Jira/Confluence/Linear/Slack integrations.
